title: BluePeak · cauda equina red flags — expedited pathway

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: Come on in, Elena. Last time we talked your lower back was still giving you trouble — how is it today?

utterances.speaker: patient
utterances.text: Honestly, not much better. It aches most of the day, and it shoots down my left leg when I sit too long.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: That radiating pain down the leg — that sounds like sciatica. On a scale of one to ten, where is it this week?

utterances.speaker: patient
utterances.text: Around a six. Some mornings a seven.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: And before I forget for the paperwork — you're still on BluePeak Health through work, right?

utterances.speaker: patient
utterances.text: Yes, same plan as last year, BluePeak Health.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: And you've kept up the physical therapy we set up?

utterances.speaker: patient
utterances.text: Yes — it's been about one week now, twice a week, plus the ibuprofen when it flares.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: I need to ask a few safety questions. Any numbness in the saddle area — groin, inner thighs? Any trouble controlling your bladder or bowels?

utterances.speaker: patient
utterances.text: Actually… yes. Since yesterday the inside of my thighs feels numb, and this morning I couldn't fully empty my bladder.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: That combination is a red flag for cauda equina syndrome and we treat it as urgent. Any fevers, unexplained weight loss, or history of cancer?

utterances.speaker: patient
utterances.text: No fevers, no weight loss, no cancer history.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: Let me take a look. Straight-leg raise on the left… tell me when it pulls.

utterances.speaker: patient
utterances.text: Right about there — that reproduces the shooting pain.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: Given those symptoms I don't want to wait any longer — I'm ordering an MRI of your lumbar spine today, on an urgent basis.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: Keep up the exercises in the meantime, and I'll have the front desk follow up about scheduling.
